transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I don't know. People just tell me they can't follow what I'm saying. My talking gets... mixed up, I guess. I try to explain things to them... like about the keys, and then the jail... the prayer rug... the chess pieces... I don't know. They just say they can't understand me. So I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high, excited, or irritable lately?

I don't know... sometimes, I guess. Sometimes I feel... real good. Like, high up. Powerful. I end up laughing and... talking real loud to everybody. 

But... if they start asking me things, questioning what I'm doing... I don't like that. I snap. Might just shout at 'em over some little thing. I just... yeah.
Have you been feeling like you have special powers or are more important than other people?

I guess... maybe. Sometimes. When I feel like that... I just know I could fix the whole building. Every floor. Better than anyone. I could probably... teach the bosses how to actually run the place. 

I don't know. I just think... maybe people all over town would know me. For... how I see things. My special way. That's all.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?

...Yeah. Sometimes. Just... when I'm working, I guess. By the vents... or the mop closet. 

I hear a man. He... he says my name. Tells me I ruined everything. It sounds real. Like... like he's standing right next to me. But nobody's there. That's it.
Do you ever hear that man's voice when you're not feeling unusually high or powerful?

...Yeah. I do. 

Even when I'm... just normal. Not feeling high up, not feeling low. Just... regular. There was a stretch, maybe... a few weeks, a month back. I was fine. But I still heard him. In the vents. 

And... I still knew the people working in the offices were doing things. Moving their pens a certain way. Coughing when I walked by. Signaling each other about me. Even when I was calm. It didn't stop.
Have you had a time when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

...Yeah. I guess so. 

Some days... bad days... I just sit there. On the edge of the bed. After my morning prayer. I just... I feel heavy. Empty. Like... what's the point? No point in getting cleaned up. No point going outside. Just... sit there.
During those times when you felt heavy and empty, did you lose interest in almost everything you usually care about?

...Yeah. I suppose. 

I used to... do things. Take pictures. Play chess. Go to the mosque. 

Just... don't care to anymore. The camera just stays in the drawer. And... when people call, neighbors I used to cook for... I just don't answer.
During those heavy, empty periods, did you ever feel worthless or guilty nearly every day?

...Yeah. 

I just... I think about things. Things I've done. I feel like... I brought shame. On my family. On the mosque. 

Every time I lose a job... every time the neighbors look at me that way... it's just... it's my fault. I deserve it. Whatever happens. I just... I deserve it.
During those heavy, empty periods, did you think about killing yourself?

...I don't know. 

I mean... sometimes. When things get real dark. 

I just... I catch myself hoping I won't wake up. Just go to sleep and... that's it. Sometimes I just think it'd be easier if I... disappeared for good.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed nearly every day and also heard the man's voice during that same period?

...I don't know. 

I guess... maybe? I mean, the voice is just... it's there a lot. And the heavy feeling... that comes and goes. 

I don't really keep track of the days like that. It's just... a lot of days.
Since these problems began, have the depressed periods made up most of the time overall?

...I guess so. 

If you add it all up... the heavy times... maybe it's been around seven months. Out of the whole time I've been sick. I just... it feels like a lot of the time.
